cases.prompt: I get StaleElementReferenceException after clicking a filter and then reading the result rows. Why?
expectations: Explains the DOM was re-rendered so the old element reference is invalid.
Fixes by locating elements again after the action, or waiting for staleness and then re-finding.
Advises against catching and retrying blindly.
